title: Wednesday's deals: Ring Battery Doorbell for £39.99, a £59.99 Ninja kettle and Lego C-3PO under £90
description: A Ring doorbell near its low, Ninja's temperature kettle at £59.99, two big Lego gifts, a £32 heated airer and a Switch 2 and AirPods price check.
intro:
Today's list mixes things already at Black Friday-level prices with a couple of cold-weather buys. The Ring Battery Video Doorbell, the Ninja Perfect Temperature Kettle and the Henry Pet vacuum are all at or close to their lowest prices of the last three months, and two big Lego gift sets are cheaper at Amazon than anywhere else.

We've also checked two things lots of people are waiting on: **AirPods and the Nintendo Switch 2**. Both are a little cheaper than their official prices, but both were cheaper still during October's Prime sale, so we'd hold off. Prices were checked on 21 October.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell (2024)
deals.note: Ignore the £79.99 'was', which it rarely sells at. What matters is that £39.99 is close to its three-month low of £34.99 and £10 less than the next cheapest shop. A fair buy now, though it could dip a few pounds more on Black Friday.

deals.name: Ninja Perfect Temperature Kettle 1.7L, Black & Copper (KT200UK)
deals.note: Lets you pick the water temperature for tea, coffee or baby bottles. It matches its Prime Day price and is about £9–£10 cheaper than at Argos, Very and AO.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars C-3PO (75398)
deals.note: £88.99 is the Prime member price; it's £99.99 without Prime. Either way it's well under the £124.99 Currys and Hamleys charge, and the lowest it's been in three months. A big display build for an adult Star Wars fan.

deals.name: Lego Harry Potter Hogwarts Castle and Grounds (76419)
deals.note: A compact model of the whole castle, about £40 less than at Argos and Currys. It has been £99 in the last few months, so this is good rather than the best we've seen.

deals.name: Henry Pet PET160 bagged cylinder vacuum
deals.note: The pet-hair version of Henry, with a turbo brush for carpets. £139 matches its three-month low, and Boots, Very and Currys are the same price, so buy wherever suits you.

deals.name: Dunelm Heated Ladder Airer (90W)
deals.note: A simple heated airer with 3m of drying space, now £8 off a price that's held since last November. Dunelm puts the running cost at around 2–3p an hour, far less than a tumble dryer.

deals.name: Ninja Creami Deluxe (NC501UK)
deals.note: The cheapest price we can find and about £40 less than AO, Very and Argos. Currys' £249.99 'was' dates from the summer, so judge it against the other shops instead. Our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the other Creami models.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Scribe (64GB, 2024)
deals.note: Still £150 off. This is the previous Scribe, but it's the lowest price it has had, and it's the one Kindle we'd buy now rather than wait on.

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: £19 off, but they were about £183 during October's Prime sale. Unless you need them now, wait. See our new [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Nintendo Switch 2 console
deals.note: £31 under the new £419.99 RRP (John Lewis is also £389). It was £354.99 a fortnight ago, so there's room to fall. More in our [Switch 2 Black Friday guide](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

The doorbell, kettle, vacuum and Lego sets are already close to their lowest prices, so there's little to gain by holding on. If one could go lower on Black Friday, it's the Ring doorbell, by a few pounds at most.

AirPods and the Switch 2 are different. Both were noticeably cheaper during Prime Big Deal Days in early October, which tells us retailers are willing to go that low again. Our two new guides have the prices to aim for: [AirPods Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2 Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

For everything else, see [Black Friday 2026: what to buy now, what to wait for, and the traps to avoid](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) and [every Black Friday guide](/black-friday/).
